apps.name: Untis+
apps.subtitle: A privacy-first companion app for WebUntis
apps.localizedDescription: Untis+ is a privacy-first companion app for WebUntis. It provides features such as timetable management, homework tracking, and notifications to help students stay organized.

versions.localizedDescription: This hotfix (build 5.4.2.1) resolves a crash some iPhone users experienced on launch when a notification was presented. It installs over 5.4.2 with the same version number, and also includes the earlier fix for local AI model downloads freezing on iOS.

This update makes notifications more reliable with smoother background handling and faster cache refreshes. You will also notice a much smoother scrolling experience when navigating through your weekly timetable.

Track your school day in real-time with new Live Activities and a highly customizable home screen widget. This update also introduces alternate app icons to personalize your device, along with full localization in German, English, Spanish, and French.
This update includes behind-the-scenes maintenance to keep Untis+ running smoothly. There are no new user-facing features in this version as we prepare for future updates.
Reverts the navigation bar to its classic design, refreshes the reload indicator across pages, updates iOS home screen widgets and fixes offline cache bugs for a smoother experience.
